title: Oscar Peterson's phone call and leaving Cannonball with Louis Hayes
summary: Peterson phones Sam in Seattle at 5 a.m. to replace Ray Brown, Louis Hayes is also asked, and Sam takes double the pay.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: You know, all they had to do was get another bass player you know, cause I was going to quit anyway and so uhm, we, out in California, no, we was out in Seattle, Washington somewhere in a hotel room, it was about 5:00 in the morning man, the phone, my phone rang you know.
And it was, picked up the phone and this was Oscar Peterson calling me from Germany saying he wanted me to join the trio.

Join the trio, I said, 'wait a minute, man, what's wrong with you,' 'I said man,' 'what's the matter with Ray Brown?' you know. He said Ray Brown is quitting the trio and he would like for me to join his trio. So, that's right on time man, cause I'm thinking about leaving Cannon. You know what I mean, so I say Damn, Boy, things are working out. I be glad man. I say 'hey, I'll do the best I can.' He say, 'look man, that's all I want you to do, the best you can.' You know what I mean, I say fine. So they had a tour and he wanted Louis Hayes, see he wanted to get Cannon's rhythm section so...
So, he sound on Hayes. Hayes called my room, said, 'Man, you know, Oscar Peterson just called me. Did he call you?' I said yeah. 'Are
you going?" "You damn right I'm going." Said, 3-19 me too." So he called Hayes first. They had a tour to do in Japan. I didn't know....Ray agreed to make the tour, to go to Japan. So Hayes left.
So now Cannon he's drugged, cause Oscar took his rhythm section, but ya see, but see he brought that shit on himself, I wouldn't have left,man, if the band had stayed the way it was, you know.
Cause I was having fun in the band, you know, we was making pretty good money.
You know, the money kept going up, tremendously, man we was making a pretty good salary.
In the band, you know, shit, but uh, Oscar was talking about double that, you know, what I mean, so you ain't gonna turn that down. And there's not that many people you see.
